messages:
Lina: spotted sampled logs with unredacted emails again from a tiny canary in ap-south-1. Only 3 traces.
Omar: which pipeline? streaming or structured?
Lina: streaming fast-path for prefetch-forwarder. Payloads were small html attachments base64-encoded. Snippet: {"body": "PGgxPkNvbnRhY3Q6IGpvZUBleGFtcGxlLmNvbTwvaDE+"} -> decodes to 'Contact: joe@example.com'
Omar: Ugh. Same class of bug we patched last week but looks like we missed prefetch-forwarder.
Lina: mitigation: set prefetch-forwarder.capture_level=meta_only for ap-south-1 and reduce sampling to 0.1%.
ci-bot: config change queued: prefetch-forwarder ap-south-1 -> capture_level=meta_only, sampling=0.1% (ETA 10m)
Omar: I'll add a tiny pre-routing decode-and-scan for base64 attachments and ship a hotfix. Add unit tests for tiny-chunk fast-path.
Lina: please also add a one-time audit query to find any other sampled objects with base64-looking content.
Omar: filing INF-4907 with repro + fix plan. PR by EOD.
Lina: thanks, will monitor S3 bucket for any new leaked items. Closing after deploy completes.
